newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Only 10,000 out of 37,000 people who came to Vavuniya from north want to return to Jaffna; others want to settle down in south because of shortages of food and medicine and lack of safety in Jaffna.
Womens groups and human rights organisations to demonstrate in Colombo demanding justice in rape and killing of Jaffna girl by soldiers and police.
Six Tamil rebel suspects detained for questioning out of 10,000 people who came to Vavuniya from north, Vavuniya senior police superintendent Gamini Silva says.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga urges international community to deny LTTE safe haven in their countries.
Killings of LTTE cadres in Paris apparently carried out by Tamils opposed to massive LTTE fund-raising campaign.
Air force destroys LTTE camp near Kilinochchi.
Security forces find two LTTE bombs meant to attack military convoys in Vavuniya.
Army kills 25 Tamil rebels in clash near Paranthan.
Killings of top LTTE cadres in Paris result of differences within LTTE, intelligence sources say.
